ValidationRule.description: A filter needs both a field and a value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISBLANK( FilterField__c ), NOT( ISBLANK( FilterValue__c ) ) ), AND( NOT( ISBLANK( FilterField__c ) ), ISBLANK( FilterValue__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Filter Field and Filter Value must both be filled or both empty.
